items.title: SOP dobara padho
items.detail: Jo likha hai, wahi poocha ja sakta hai. Har line pe bol pao.

items.title: Kyun ye course?
items.detail: Ye sawaal pakka aayega. Seedha, apna jawab tayyar rakho.

items.title: Apne sawaal bhi poocho
items.detail: Course, projects ya student life ke baare mein ek do sawaal rakho.

items.title: Tech check pehle
items.detail: Camera, mic, internet aur shant kamra. Pehle test karo.

youtube.title: University interview call aaya? 4 tips
youtube.description:
University interview se pehle: apni SOP dobara padho, 'kyun ye course' ka jawab tayyar rakho, apne sawaal bhi poocho, aur camera, mic aur internet pehle test karo.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
